mistral.notes: Public OpenAPI 3.1. Classify chat/fim/agents as chat, embeddings, moderation, audio/transcriptions; drop fine-tuning, batch, files, admin.

replicate.notes: Official OpenAPI. Generation is POST /v1/predictions (and official model run paths). Platform account/collections/hardware classify null. listModels is paginated. Auth: Bearer token. outputStrategy post-200 (prediction object is the ack).

groq.notes: OpenAI-compatible, no stable public spec URL. Use fetchOpenAiCompatibleSpec. Prefer resolving a live Stainless spec from groq-python/groq-typescript .stats.yml if one exists; otherwise generated from the OpenAI spec.

fireworks.notes: OpenAI-compatible inference API. Use openai-compat helper. Confirm models URL; some docs use GET /inference/v1/models.

together.notes: Published OpenAPI 3.1 (generated file on docs.together.ai). Classify chat/completions; drop fine-tune, files, endpoints admin.

voyage.notes: Official spec repo voyage-ai/openapi. Embeddings + rerank. Rerank is not in our activity enum — classify null. Confirm the raw spec filename if yaml 404s.

cohere.notes: Official YAML. Chat (v2/chat or /chat) + embed. Classify rerank/classify/datasets/finetune/admin as null. Auth Bearer.

deepseek.notes: OpenAI-compatible. Paths may be /chat/completions (server already includes no /v1) or /v1/chat/completions. Confirm against docs and set serverUrl accordingly.

moonshot.notes: Kimi / Moonshot OpenAI-compatible. International host may be api.moonshot.ai — prefer the host the key is issued for (cn vs ai) and document it.

dashscope.notes: Use the OpenAI-compatible mode, not the native DashScope protocol. Intl host vs dashscope.aliyuncs.com (China). Prefer intl unless the key is CN-only.

deepgram.notes: Official OpenAPI (also github.com/deepgram/deepgram-api-specs). Listen/speak/agent audio. Drop project/key management. Auth is often Token or Authorization: Token.

assemblyai.notes: Official OpenAPI titled AssemblyAI API. Transcript + streaming. No classic /models list — listModels may return a small curated set or skip with a documented empty catalog. Do not use the mintlify plant-store placeholder at /docs/api-reference/openapi.json.

runway.notes: Stainless spec in github.com/runwayml/openapi. Find the actual yaml path (branch may not be main). Auth X-Runway-Version + Bearer. Classify generation POSTs; drop task GET/cancel as platform.

cartesia.notes: Mintlify docs. Hunt for a real OpenAPI (docs.cartesia.ai/openapi.json may 429). TTS bytes/sse + STT. Requires Cartesia-Version header. Voices list stands in for models if there is no /models.

perplexity.notes: Published OpenAPI 3.1. Paths include /v1/sonar (chat). May have no /models — if so listModels returns [] without skipped, or a documented static catalog.

jina.notes: Official OpenAPI (embeddings, rerank, classifier, reader). Only embeddings classify; rerank/classify/reader are null.

stability.notes: No clean public openapi.json (HTML docs). Prefer any official spec if found; otherwise a focused docs-derived spec for v2beta stable-image generate/upscale/edit. Auth Bearer. v1 engines/list may still work for models.

bfl.notes: Official OpenAPI at api.bfl.ai. FLUX image (and maybe video) POSTs. Utility/finetune/admin classify null. If no /models, derive model ids from path names or a small curated list.

kling.notes: No public OpenAPI. Auth may be JWT from access key+secret rather than a single bearer — if the provided KLING_API_KEY is a ready-to-use bearer, use it; otherwise document skip of listModels and still ship the spec. Hand-write the text2video/image2video/image generation POSTs from official docs.

novita.notes: OpenAI-compatible plus image. Confirm path prefix (v3/openai). docs.novita.ai/openapi.json is markdown, not a spec.

reactor.notes: No public OpenAPI (api.reactor.inc/openapi.json 404s). Real-time world/video models over WebRTC sendCommand; HTTP control plane is POST /tokens (Reactor-API-Key) and POST /sessions. Catalog is public GET /pricing (keyless). Connect slugs come from each model's docs page (reactor/helios, x2, …). Runtime compiles per-model OpenAPI after session connect — we cannot fetch that without a GPU session.
